### Run Nuvio from the AI agent you already use

Connect ChatGPT, Claude (the app or Claude Code) or Grok Bot to Nuvio and ask it to handle the everyday tasks: add an expense, create a customer, record a payment or match a bank transaction to an invoice. When you connect, you sign in with your Nuvio account and choose which company the agent works in. The agent can only do what your role allows, and a built-in safeguard stops it from saving the same entry twice by accident. To set it up, go to Settings > Profile > AI agents. That page walks you through each agent step by step and lists every agent you've connected, with its company, when it was last used and a Disconnect button.

## Nuvio 5: AI that gets things done

Nuvio 5 is here, and it's about taking routine work off your plate. The assistant inside Nuvio can now take action as well as answer questions. With Nuvio MCP, you can also connect the AI agent you already use, such as ChatGPT, Claude or Grok Bot, and what it does lands right in Nuvio. Bank reconnects are also easier, overdraft balances now match your bank, and long scanned invoices keep every line.

### Run Nuvio from the AI agent you already use [...] ### A redesigned income and expense flow

Creating and editing income and expenses is rebuilt from the ground up. Pick Easy or Advanced entry, enter the amount, view your receipt side by side, and save from a sticky bar that stays put as you work.

### Nuvio AI, rebuilt

The AI chat has a new interface with searchable history, a redesigned session sidebar, one-click copy, and credit usage tracking. Ask questions about your finances in plain language and get answers from an upgraded model.

### Collaborate on any entry

Leave comment threads on income and expense records so your team can discuss a transaction without switching to email or Slack.

An AI-powered platform that handles your income, expenses, and cash flow, letting you focus on what matters.

## Overview

Nuvio is an AI-powered financial management platform designed to simplify and automate your personal finances. Unlike traditional budgeting apps, Nuvio leverages advanced AI to intelligently analyze your income and expenses, providing you with insightful forecasts and proactive recommendations to optimize your cash flow and achieve your financial goals. Its user-friendly interface and intuitive design make managing your money less stressful and more efficient.

## Key Features [...] ## Key Features

 AI-powered financial analysis: Automatically categorizes transactions, identifies spending patterns, and predicts future cash flow.
 Personalized financial insights and recommendations: Provides tailored advice based on your individual financial situation and goals.
 Automated budgeting and forecasting: Creates and updates your budget automatically, offering accurate predictions of your future financial health.
 Secure and encrypted data storage: Keeps your financial information safe and protected.

## Use Cases

 Individuals looking to improve their personal financial management.
 Entrepreneurs and freelancers needing better control over their income and expenses.
 Anyone seeking a more intuitive and efficient way to track and analyze their finances.
